title: Access Genie Retail — SMARTAPPS by Blue Cloud Softech
description: From passive CCTV to actionable retail intelligence. Sixteen measured operational KPIs across sales, risk and operations, with camera evidence against every one.

hero.tagline: From passive CCTV to actionable retail intelligence.
hero.lede: Sixteen measured operational KPIs across sales, risk and operations, with camera evidence against every one.

modules.title: 16 KPIs and the platform foundation
modules.lede: Every KPI has a defined trigger, the evidence it keeps, where it is delivered and the business impact it measures.

items.name: Customer Walk-ins & Headcount
items.tag: Footfall Counting, Peak Traffic & Forensic Face Embeddings
items.summary: Monitors customer walk-in volume and group size entering through showroom vestibules. Stores 512-dimensional facial vector embeddings securely in Milvus Vector DB to provide instantaneous forensic evidence if any security dispute or high-value loss occurs.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Customer enters showroom across vestibule tripwire; groups tallied

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Timestamped head count tally + 512-d ArcFace facial vector embedding in Milvus DB

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Live Dashboard, WhatsApp Summary, PDF Nightly

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Accurate footfall baseline for sales conversion; instant forensic identification without scrubbing hours of video.

items.name: Display Ornaments Counter
items.tag: Counter Table Dwell & Presented Jewellery Tracking
items.summary: Detects when a customer is seated at a sales consultation table and audits the exact count of jewellery trays and ornaments presented by the sales associate. Prevents counter overcrowding, measures customer engagement, and correlates presentation depth with closing rates.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Customer seated at table; velvet trays placed; items audited continuously

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Bounding box snapshot of displayed jewellery pieces + table dwell duration

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Live Dashboard, Floor Manager Alert

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Ensures sales staff adhere to luxury presentation standards; prevents unattended clutter and loss on tables.

items.name: Try-On & Purchase Selection Analytics
items.summary: Uses upper-body pose estimation to detect when a customer tries on a necklace, ring, bangle or earrings in front of mirrors. Logs try-on duration and interaction intensity, and flags the final ornament selected for purchase.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Hand-to-neck/ear/wrist gesture detected while viewing mirror

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Pose interaction snapshot + try-on item ID & conversion selection flag

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Daily Merchandising Intelligence Report

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Identifies top-performing designs and provides high-intent buyer analytics to retail merchandising executives.

items.name: Store Opening & Closing Shutter Compliance
items.summary: Monitors the opening and closing of store motorized shutters and heavy velvet security curtains. Strictly enforces the chain’s dual-witness security protocol, ensuring 2+ authorized staff members are verified present before opening or after closing.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Shutter/curtain motion; requires 2+ authorized staff witnesses

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Dual-witness arrival snapshots + opening/closing timestamp compliance log

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: WhatsApp Alert, Central Security Console

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Eliminates lone-worker insider theft risks during high-vulnerability morning and night transitions.

items.name: Security Frisking & Keypoint Checks
items.tag: Human Frisking Pose Estimation & Anatomical Keypoint Coverage
items.summary: Monitors security guards performing frisking on staff and visitors entering or exiting. Using 17-keypoint skeleton pose tracking, it verifies whether all mandated body zones (torso, arms, pockets, waistband, lower legs) were systematically scanned, with video proof archived.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Staff/visitor enters checkpoint; audits all body touchpoint scans

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: 10-second proof video clip + SHA-256 hash + keypoint coverage %

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Security Vault, CSO Audit Log

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Guarantees 100% adherence to loss-prevention frisking; stops weapon or tool ingress and jewellery shrinkage.

items.name: Vault Opening & Dual-Custodian Audit
items.tag: Strongroom Access, Multi-Angle Snapshots (P1, P2, Door)
items.summary: Monitors the high-security jewellery strongroom 24/7. Upon vault door motion, the system captures synchronized multi-angle snapshots: Person 1 (P1), Person 2 (P2) and the Vault Door. Enforces dual-custodian authorization and alerts on single-person breaches.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Vault door motion; validates dual authorized keyholders present

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Triple synchronized snapshots: Person 1 (P1), Person 2 (P2), Vault Door

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Urgent WhatsApp to CSO & Store Head

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Strict physical dual-control of the highest-value inventory in the store; provides an unalterable audit trail.

items.name: Security Guard Absence Monitoring
items.tag: Post Dwell Tracking & >15 Minutes Absence Escalation
items.summary: Continuously verifies that assigned security guard posts at main entrances, vaults and billing counters remain occupied. If a guard vacates the assigned post for more than 15 minutes continuously during business hours, a high-severity alert is immediately raised to the Store Manager.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Guard vacates designated geofence post for >15 minutes continuously

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Absence timer stopwatch log + empty post camera snapshot

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: WhatsApp Ping to Store Head & Agency SLA Log

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Maintains active deterrence at all showroom gates; ensures security agencies fulfil contractual staffing SLAs.

items.name: Empty Racks & Jewellery Displacement
items.summary: Audits high-value diamond and gold showcases, wall display cabinets and counter trays. Logs when jewellery is placed and removed, flags prolonged empty display slots, and triggers an anti-robbery alert if multiple trays are removed abruptly without customer consultation.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Jewellery tray removed from rack; flags prolonged vacancy or abrupt removal

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Showcase slot vacancy heatmap + displacement event timestamp

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Dashboard Telemetry, Anti-Robbery Siren

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Prevents internal shrinkage during stock transitions and provides early warning during smash-and-grab attempts.

items.name: Frisking Bag Screening Compliance
items.summary: Verifies that security guards inspect all staff backpacks, handbags and visitor tote bags upon entry and exit. Guarantees that bags are physically opened and inspected under camera view before clearance is granted.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Staff or visitor carry-on bag crosses screening without full inspection

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Open bag inspection pose snapshot vs uninspected bypass alert frame

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Security Post Monitor, Daily Compliance Report

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Stops illicit transport of jewellery, loose diamonds or dangerous articles in or out of store premises.

items.name: After-Hours Perimeter Intruder Detection
items.tag: Night Vision IR Human Silhouette & Tripwire Trigger
items.summary: Arms automatically once store shutters are locked (e.g. 21:30 IST). Continuously scans low-light showroom floors, back offices and vault perimeters, and dispatches an instant emergency alert if an unauthorized person is detected after hours.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Human silhouette or motion in darkened showroom during closed hours

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Night-vision IR snapshot with bounding box + instant alarm clip

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Emergency Siren, Central Command, Police Dispatch

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Protects high-value retail assets 24/7/365; eliminates vulnerability during holidays and overnight hours.

items.name: Hospitality Service On-Time
items.tag: Luxury Customer Seating to Service Stopwatch
items.summary: Measures the duration from when a customer sits at a showroom sales table until a hospitality team member or sales associate attends to them with welcome refreshments, water or product catalogues, ensuring the chain’s luxury hospitality standards are consistently maintained.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Customer seated; associates deliver water/refreshments within benchmark

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Stopwatch timer record (e.g. 7 seconds) + arrival confirmation frame

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Live Dashboard Hospitality Scorecard

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Enhances luxury brand prestige; seated customers feel immediately valued upon arrival.

items.name: Hospitality Service Late Escalation Alarm
items.tag: Delayed Service Alarm (>5 Minutes Dwell Alert)
items.summary: Triggers an operational alarm whenever a seated customer remains unattended past acceptable hospitality thresholds (e.g. >5 minutes 1 second), and sends an immediate ping to the Floor Manager to deploy staff before customer frustration sets in.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Customer seated and unattended for >5 minutes without service

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Elapsed dwell snapshot (5m 1s) + unattended table coordinates

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Floor Manager Handheld Ping & Dashboard Alarm

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Significantly reduces customer walk-outs and negative reviews due to unattended consultation tables.

items.name: Meet & Greet Protocol (“Atithi Devo Bhava”)
items.summary: Enforces the chain’s foundational philosophy of “Atithi Devo Bhava”. Detects entering customers and verifies whether designated showroom reception hosts welcome them with a traditional Namaste within 10 seconds of crossing the door.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Customer enters; staff host must perform welcoming Namaste in <10s

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: 10-second reception pose verification snapshot + store greeting %

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Executive Scorecard, Area Head Dashboard

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Creates an exceptional first impression and establishes customer loyalty from the very first step.

items.name: Clear Counter Safety Protocol
items.tag: Prompt Counter Clearance & Inventory Safe Return
items.summary: Monitors consultation counters after customer departure. Verifies that diamond and gold ornaments are promptly counted, repacked into secure trays and returned to locked safes or display cases rather than left unattended on open tables.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Customer departs; jewellery trays left unattended on table >15 mins

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Customer departure timestamp + exposed ornaments on counter snapshot

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Floor Manager Alert, Stock Audit Log

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Prevents opportunist theft or inventory misplacement; keeps sales counters impeccably organized.

items.name: Floor Mopping & Store Hygiene Standards
items.summary: Audits pre-opening showroom cleaning routines (08:00–09:30 AM) and evening maintenance. Tracks housekeeping staff using mops and cleaning equipment across all floor aisles, ensuring pristine hygiene benchmarks for luxury jewellery buyers.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: Housekeeping floor mopping verified during morning routine (08:00–09:30)

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Mop trajectory floor coverage heatmap + pre-opening hygiene certificate

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Store Manager Hygiene Sign-Off

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Ensures showroom floors, mirrors and display cases maintain luxury brand standards.

items.name: Staff Gathering & Loitering Detection
items.summary: Identifies instances where 3 or more sales associates cluster together for informal conversation while customer tables remain unattended. Generates floor productivity analytics to maintain professional showroom decorum.

details.label: Trigger
details.text: 3+ sales staff congregating for >3 mins while customer tables unattended

details.label: Evidence kept
details.text: Spatial cluster bounding box frame + unattended counter status

details.label: Delivered to
details.text: Floor Productivity Console, Floor Lead Alert

details.label: Business impact
details.text: Boosts floor staff utilization and prevents customers from waiting unattended.

items.name: Camera heartbeat
items.summary: Continuous polling across every camera endpoint, with automated escalation to technicians before a blind spot can be exploited.

items.name: Daily executive summaries
items.summary: An automated scorecard every night: store-wise KPIs, violation logs and conversion metrics, delivered to leadership.

items.name: Super admin portal
items.summary: Add stores, register camera streams, assign role-based permissions and tune KPI thresholds.

sections.title: Overview
sections.html:
Manual monitoring of thousands of cameras is physically impossible. For a luxury jewellery chain running dozens of branches, a traditional CCTV setup is a purely passive archive — incidents are noticed hours or days after they happen. Access Genie turns the same cameras into an operational intelligence engine with sixteen measured KPIs.

Reference deployment figures. The numbers above describe one live jewellery-chain deployment and are stated as reference information, not as a universal guarantee of what any other customer will see.

Enterprise safeguards

  • Evidence integrity — every alert clip and snapshot is cryptographically stamped with a hash and a UTC timestamp, preventing tampering and supporting legal admissibility.
  • Camera uptime monitoring — continuous polling across the estate, with automated escalation to technicians before blind spots can be exploited.
  • Single administrative pane — stores, streams, permissions and KPI thresholds managed in one place, with roles scoped per function.
  • Daily executive scorecard — generated automatically each night and delivered to leadership, so the picture does not depend on anyone compiling it.
